method: No test reruns or imports. AST method ordering and retained unittest progress characters identify the five skipped tests; source decorators identify their scope.
runner_behavior: pythonbuild.testdist.main always invokes run_custom_unittests once. --stdlib additionally invokes run_stdlib_tests, so the separate custom invocation and XML-stdlib invocation each run the same22-test custom suite. One22/5 summary is in pbs-custom-tests.log and the other in pbs-xml-tests.log; they are not two distinct custom suites.

skip_classification.test_curses_interactive: Interactive curses/terminal test. Linux excludes the Windows predicate; absence of TERM is the remaining source skip condition.
skip_classification.test_gil_disabled: Py_GIL_DISABLED/free-threading build configuration; gated to Python3.13+, unavailable for the tested3.12.13 interpreter.
skip_classification.test_ssl_with_keylogfile: Windows-specific OpenSSL uplink/SSLKEYLOGFILE regression; excluded on the tested Linux build.
skip_classification.test_tkinter: GUI/Tcl/Tk construction test, gated on DISPLAY and TCL_LIBRARY. Terse progress output identifies the skipped test but does not distinguish which missing-variable predicate fired.
skip_classification.test_zstd_multithreaded: compression.zstd worker support; gated to Python3.14+, unavailable for3.12.13.

scope: The five skips cover terminal/GUI, Windows SSL behavior and features introduced after Python3.12; none is an Expat/XML test.
Each custom invocation reports22 tests with5 skips, therefore17 non-skipped successful tests. Repetition under --stdlib does not double unique test coverage.
The six installed XML modules and their802 reported tests/13 skips are a separate stdlib result, outside these custom-suite counts.
